each: bend.camera({ yaw: 0.25 }); if (t > 1.0) { const w = bend.worlds.find((x) => x.id === 'pool'); for (const d of bend.show.dancers) { const J = d.skeleton.world; for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) w.ripple(J[0] + Math.sin(t * 9 + k * 2.1) * 0.5, J[2] + Math.cos(t * 7 + k * 2.1) * 0.5, 1.2, 0.18); } }
